clues: This city lies in Russia, near its border with China. The land of China begins just a short trip away.
Winters here are strong and cold, yet summers turn hot and humid. The seasons swing hard in this inland place.
This city led the Far East district for years. In December 2018, that top role passed to Vladivostok.
This city once went by a different old name. It took its name of today in the year 1893.
Two great rivers meet right at this city. They are the Amur River and the Ussuri River.
